child.label: Body Language & Voice
child.description: Questions about the answerer's body language and voice while talking to people: eye contact, gestures, facial expression, posture, distance, and vocal variety.
child.not_for: How sociable, talkative, assertive, energetic, or thrill-seeking the answerer is in general (use Sociability & Energy).
examples: Do you maintain eye contact while talking?
Do you gesture a lot when you talk?

child.label: Sociability & Energy
child.description: Questions about how sociable, talkative, assertive, cheerful, energetic, or thrill-seeking the answerer is, and whether they enjoy crowds and attention.
child.not_for: Eye contact, gestures, posture, facial expression, and tone of voice during conversation (use Body Language & Voice).
